method.distance: symmetric Chamfer: mean of both directed means; p95 of concatenated boundary distances
method.translation_diagnostic: diagnostic grid dx,dy in {-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1} px; no scale/rotation/box fit
method.area: signed shoelace area in physical pixel coordinates; relative signed-area bias; no bitmap threshold
method.source_placement: exact generator nominal positions from source_font_control.positions_for_page (Pillow font metrics only for generator-compatible baseline/size), source TTF outlines from oracle font path
method.embedded_placement: actual PDF CID→GID and Tm from audit.py placements; actual embedded TTFont glyph outlines; actual MediaBox
method.limitations: TTFont design outlines and PDF GID/Tm mapping are exact vector geometry, but flattening and nearest-point metrics are sampled approximations; raster hinting is intentionally excluded. Adobe Type 3 geometry is not included.
